description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)” on the x-axis and two metrics—“Perplexity” on the left y-axis and “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)” on the right y-axis—for different configurations. The x-axis, labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)”, ranges from 0 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 20. The left y-axis, labeled “Perplexity”, ranges from 4.2 to 4.7, and the right y-axis, labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)”, ranges from 40 to 100. Four lines are plotted: “Perplexity” is shown as a solid orange line with circle markers, starting at approximately 4.62 and ending at approximately 4.38, showing a general downward trend before leveling off. “Full Cache PPL” is a dashed red line with square markers, remaining constant at approximately 4.4 across the entire x-axis range. “GPU Mem. Ratio” is a solid blue line with circle markers, starting at approximately 42, rising to approximately 98 at the end of the x-axis, and showing a steep increase after the 80% mark. “Full Cache GPU Mem.” is a dashed blue line with circle markers, positioned near the top of the right y-axis, remaining constant at 100% across the entire x-axis range.
